affinity.notes: Bark, roots, vines, and canopy define the body without dominant magical construction.

anatomy.notes: Humanoid trunk and root limbs remain legible despite dense foliage.

archetype.notes: Sovereign guardian and tank communicates the walking-forest duty.

counterplay.notes: Towering mass, rooted stance, and long branch arms suggest slow, wide-reaching attacks and mobility limitations.

finish.notes: Richly organic surface treatment stays grounded.

framing.notes: Towering vertical composition strongly sells sovereign scale.

identity.notes: Elder tree colossus identifies the World Tree Warden form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T5; exact intended tier is T5.
